about: RELEASE-2-SPEC section 8, "The acceptance table", as rows the bench judge (judge.py) reads. Written by lane M unchanged from the specification; a gate is moved only in the open, in the specification, with its reason, never at run time. The A-derived values - each row's a_recorded, a_spread and gain spread, each no-worse-than-A gate's floor_factor (C5: 1 + 2 x its A/A spread) - are written by judge.py floors from a valid A/A pair of release 1 measured on this host before any B (D-R2-44); until then "derived" is null and the judge answers INVALID wherever one is needed.

rules.a_column: the session's A against a_recorded (judge.py floors), else section 8's a_section8, within the larger of 20%, 2 x a_spread and a_step / a_recorded (an Event Timing row's 8 ms step)
rules.order: A B A B A B, three rounds each, one part group at a time (bench_run.py --order)

derived.rule: derive(): for every row that reads A, a_recorded = both A/A rounds pooled in the row's own statistic (2 decimals), a_spread = up_spread of the two rounds' values in that statistic (|a - b| / mean, rounded up at 4 decimals), the same spread as the row's gain spread and on each no-worse-than-A gate with floor_factor = 1 + 2 x it (C5); rows: {row id: [round 1, round 2, pooled]}; sha256 of the rows
